name: UI UX Pro Max
summary: An AI skill that helps with UI and UX design across several platforms and frameworks. Its design system generator reads your project requirements and produces a tailored set of recommendations covering page pattern, visual style, colors, typography, key effects and anti-patterns to avoid.
install_steps: See the repository README for install steps
example_use_case: You are building a landing page for a wellness spa and want a complete design system, with page structure, color palette, font pairing and a pre-delivery checklist, before writing any front-end code.
